note: Uniqueness rules per family (05_asset_manifest.md section 5). Thresholds are Hamming distances of the 64-bit hashes (the larger of dHash and aHash); two assets of one group closer than the threshold are NEAR_DUPLICATE. Caps are design targets; the report prints the real histogram.
